lines: Our forgotten smiles, if it’s just the two of us
Even if there is a future different from now
Surely the heart pulls the thread that connects
May the me of those days awaken
If you stretch out your hand, you could touch
If you close your eyes, even the little pain
Even if blown by the wind, lost alone
The heart forever keeps its hands spread, protecting
Until the you of those days looks back
Wide open ears (feel something, feel nothing, listen closely, listen closely)
In the constant moment (You will find me where is quiet, listen closely, listen closely)
Let the blood flow through all the spaces of the universe
Even if there is a future different from now
Surely the heart pulls the thread that connects
May the me of those days awaken
